content: Taugu Pol, Mamaitua na taunoyama be Yesu Keriso na apasolma. Bada taugu ya vineguna da Mamaitua na vinevinema, banegidima yà sagudi da adi waisumaḡama èi rewa panana. Be mate riukaua yài katakataidi da taudi Mamaitua na ḡoane ta miana.
Inam waisumeḡine tauda tè kataiena da tokare yawasana kenakena nonoḡinama tà paḡona, vutuna Mamaitua boni ya sausaugena, muriḡa da yaba matabuna yai tubuḡidina. Be Mamaitua nam airaḡan e kaiyovueda.
Be raḡan boruborune tauna inam varinama yai maḡatarina. Be Mamaitua tauwai yawasanidama ya vineguna da taugu inam varinama banaga ḡarodie yà rauguguyena.
Tam Taitos ḡarome uma letanama yà girugirumina. Am waisumaḡe tam taugu natuḡomiguma. Tamadama Mamaitua be tauwai yawasanidama Yesu Keriso adi raukiviverema be adi subama ḡarome ta kenana.
Taitos Kret nopone ekalesia babadidima e vinedina
Tam Kret bonabonane è gosemna, baninama dà noyama kwa kaiḡavutinama aubainama, tam meagai da meagai nopodiḡa kwa naḡo be ekalesia adi babadama kwa vinedina.

Be ekalesia debanama tauwai badenama tauna sibo tauḡoma, be tauna na yawasanama sibo umanama: • Tauna yawasana didimanine e mia be nam aba e voia waigewa da banaga tai giugiue. • Be tauna waivi tenaḡa e naḡi be vutunaḡa e rabena. • Be na sedama sibo waisumeḡidima be nam beapotepotedi be rawarawa ḡaiḡaidi.

• Be mate ekalesia debanama tauwai badenama tauna Mamaitua noya ya utena aubainama umanama yawasanidie sibo ya miana. • Tauna yawasana didimanine e miana, be nam aba sibo ya voia waigewa da banaga ai giugiue. • Be tauna nam e kawa saḡe munaḡe be banaga matedie e rauguyaguyau, • be nam meditupo banegina, • be nam tegobua banegina, • be nam sorukeakea banegina, • be nam kaiyovue e rarau mane bo e rarau purapura. •

Be banaga na vadae ta tavatavana taurabe kauedima. • Be tauna yawasana veredima tauḡoedima. • Be inam baneginama tauna miamia genuaninama, be nam voivoia yabayababina, • be tauna na noḡotama matabudi didimanidiḡa, • be tauna Mamaitua na ḡoane nama e mianana, • be na yawasanae tauname e rabe munaḡena. •

Ekalesia debanama tauwai badenama tauna Mamaitua riunama awai katakataina, vutudi e kaidididi da bagibaginaḡa. Inam raḡanine tauna tokare teneḡinama da inam waikatakataidie sibo banaga ḡesaudima mate yai katakataidi be ya riutuaḡaiedina. Be riukaua tauriutuatuaḡaienama banegidima, dabudi ta kita be ta kataie da taudi inam ta kaikaiyovuna.

Baninama banaga toitoi riukaua tauriutuatuaḡaienama be tauboru waideḡa banegidima ta miamiana. Inam kaua Jius banegidima adi voia ḡomama nama, taudi ta riuriuna da banaga tarawatu tai muriwatanena, yodibe yawasana ta paḡona. Be inam giudima matabudi kaiyovu.
Inam banegidima kwa riutuaḡaiedina, baninama taudi adi waikatakataima kaikaiyovune dam toitoi adi waisumaḡama ta kawakawa gewegewedina. Inam tauwai katakatai kaikaiyovudima maneḡa tawai matanedina.
Boni nuauyauya baneginama tenaḡa Kret nopone tauna umanama ya riuna, “Kret banegidima taudi matabudi kaikaiyovudima, kivikorokorodima, matagayagayawidima be kaniposa banegidima.”
Inam riukaua. Vutuna aubainama kwa riutuaḡai vavasaḡedi be kwa voiedi da adi waisumaḡama Bada ḡarone ei rewapanana,
be nam Jius adi giuma kaikaiyovudima bo adi tarawatuma tai beavaiedi. Be banaga aitauḡa riukaua taumia tautaurienama nam adi giuma ta vaiedi be tai muriwatanedi.

Aitauḡa nopodie nam mira, taudi ḡarodie yaba matabudi nam miremiredi. Be aitauḡa nopodie mira be nam timawai sumaḡana, taudi ḡarodie yaba matabudi miremiredima, baninama taudi nopodima be adi noḡotama a mirana.

Taudi ta riuriuna da Mamaitua kabe ti katakataie, be adi yawasanama ewai maḡataridina da taudi Mamaitua nam ti kataiena. Taudi rawaḡaiḡai banegidima be banaga tawai mataravuḡeidina. Taudi nam tokare aiyaba verenama ta voie be teneteneḡina, ibewa ḡoma.
